meta.question: Add dissolved O2 (the radiobiological oxygen effect / OER) — does the eaq/H scavenging by background O2 reproduce dose-dependent radical depletion?
meta.method: First-order O2 scavenger in the IRT worker (heap self-event, gj=-99 sentinel): eaq+O2->O2- (k 1.74e10), H+O2->HO2 (k 2.1e10), rate k*[O2]. Tested on the 100 keV proton over [O2] = 0 / 50 / 250 uM.

result.headline: Dissolved O2 scavenges eaq dose-dependently (0.309 -> 0.006 from anoxic to aerated) — the molecular basis of the OER (why hypoxic tumours are radioresistant). Anoxic (0 uM) preserves prior behaviour (safe).
result.limits: Transient O2-/HO2 still funnel to ~0 by 1us in the isolated per-primary track; the full OER = DNA-damage ratio (aerated/anoxic) is the next step (score SSB/DSB with vs without O2).

status: pass — oxygen-effect mechanism live (dose-dependent eaq scavenging by dissolved O2)
